entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and mind mage who planeswalks from Zendikar to Innistrad to establish a foothold for the Gatewatch against Emrakul.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who wields a sural and follows Jace to Innistrad, clearing a path for the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A fire-wielding planeswalker whose flames are the Gatewatch's weapon against Emrakul.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who uses her planar glyph to tap the leylines of a plane; here she tries to tap Innistrad's.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who leads an undead army, carries the Chain Veil, and rescues the Gatewatch in Thraben.

entities.name: Gared
entities.description: A geistmage's apprentice with a bulging eye and an asymmetrical body who serves Liliana.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The third Eldrazi titan, an eldritch monstrosity moving on Thraben and mutating Innistrad's people and creatures.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers Jace rallies to destroy Emrakul.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A cold plane of eternal dusk, whose sky is tearing apart as Emrakul arrives.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where Jace went to rally the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The densest city of life on Innistrad, half ablaze and overrun by Emrakul's legion.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane Gideon is teased about stopping over in for snacks.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A place where Nissa fought alongside vampires, pirates and worse.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An object Liliana carries that hovers near her fingertips; Nissa calls it an abomination and Gideon calls it a problem.

entities.name: Cryptolith network
entities.description: A network that focuses all of Innistrad's leylines toward Thraben, drawing Emrakul there.

entities.name: Hedron network
entities.description: A network on Zendikar that Jace compares to the cryptolith network.

entities.name: Planar glyph
entities.description: Nissa's magic for tapping a plane's leyline network so its energy can be channeled through Chandra.

entities.name: Leylines
entities.description: Lines of a plane's energy that the plan depends on and that Emrakul's arrival has redirected.

entities.name: Werewolves
entities.description: Mad, lattice-marked werewolves that attack Jace on the hill; one mutates when he overloads its mind.

events.summary: Jace arrives on Innistrad, finds the sky tearing apart, and stands on a hill above burning Thraben.
events.quote: He could see the city now, and half of it was ablaze.

events.summary: Jace overloads the minds of three mad werewolves; two die and the third mutates into something unrecognizable.
events.quote: Whatever he had done had triggered some sort of reflexive mutation.

events.summary: Gideon arrives and slays the mutated creature as it corners Jace.
events.quote: "It's fine, Jace. I've got your back."

events.summary: Chandra and Nissa arrive, and Jace lays out the plan: Nissa taps the leylines with her glyph, Gideon clears a path, and Chandra channels the energy.
events.quote: Nissa will use her planar glyph to tap into the leyline network.

events.summary: Nissa warns the plan will fail because the leylines have been redirected into the cryptolith network at Thraben, and after listening she agrees she can do it.
events.quote: "It's not going to work. The leylines have already been redirected. Into that."

events.summary: Liliana watches the Gatewatch head into Thraben from above, with Gared and her raised army.
events.quote: Those must be Jace's little friends.

events.summary: Chandra unleashes a huge firestorm against the mutated horde, scorching her friends, and the group is trapped in a market square.
events.quote: They were trapped in what had been a market square

events.summary: Jace has Chandra topple a lattice-scarred tower with two fireballs to block a street.
events.quote: Seconds later, the entire structure collapsed, blocking off most of the street

events.summary: Nissa begins the planar glyph in the market square while Gideon charges the horde to protect her.
events.quote: He roared a challenge as he slashed in a wide circle

events.summary: Nissa pulls up three spectral vines to tap the leylines; the third, darker vine strangles her.
events.quote: it had managed to wrap itself around her neck

events.summary: Nissa cries out and collapses; the glyph goes dark and the plan fails as the horde keeps coming.
Chandra refuses to leave: they all walk out together or not at all.
events.quote: "Not gonna happen. We're all walking out of here together, or..."

events.summary: Liliana's zombie army pours into the square and forms a defensive perimeter around the planeswalkers.
events.quote: they parted, formed a defensive perimeter around them, and started pushing outward.

events.summary: Liliana appears with the Chain Veil and wipes out the mutated creatures with necromantic energy, rescuing the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Liliana floated forth, arms spread wide, the Chain Veil hovering just beyond her fingertips.

events.summary: Nissa and Gideon recoil from the Chain Veil, while Chandra defends Liliana as having saved them.
Jace refuses Liliana's demand to planeswalk away, insisting they can finish the job with her help.
events.quote: We need to finish this. We're so close.

events.summary: Gideon asks Jace to decide whether Liliana can be trusted, and Liliana asks what their plan is now.
events.quote: So tell me, brave heroes, what's your plan now?

relations.note: Gared addresses Liliana as mistress and is her geistmage's apprentice.
relations.quote: "Yes, mistress. S'what it does around here, mostly."

relations.note: Gideon follows Jace to Innistrad and saves him.
relations.quote: "It's fine, Jace. I've got your back."

relations.note: Chandra defends Liliana as having saved them.
relations.quote: "The nice lady with the uncomfortable dress just saved our butts, Gideon. Calm down a second."

relations.note: The Gatewatch aims to destroy Emrakul.
relations.quote: it would take all of them to destroy the eldritch monstrosity.
